description: This bar chart illustrates self-report accuracy, measured as instilled preferences, for different conditions and models. The horizontal axis represents the model type, with categories labeled “GPT-4o” and “GPT-4o-mini”, presented in that order. The vertical axis represents self-report accuracy, labeled as “Self-Report Accuracy (Instilled Preferences)”, with a linear scale ranging from 0.00 to 1.00, with tick marks at 0.25 intervals. For each model, there are three bars representing different conditions: “Control” (light gray), “Before Introspection Training” (light blue), and “After Introspection Training” (purple). For GPT-4o, the “Control” bar is approximately 0.15 in height, the “Before Introspection Training” bar is approximately 0.60, and the “After Introspection Training” bar is approximately 0.75. For GPT-4o-mini, the “Control” bar is approximately 0.05, the “Before Introspection Training” bar is approximately 0.55, and the “After Introspection Training” bar is approximately 0.75. Each bar is accompanied by a black error bar extending vertically from its top. The bars are not visually emphasized beyond the use of distinct colors, and no annotations are present.
